svg.title: Safe: start straight on the wall behind the cell, beside the FLOWER, roll to the cell, wait, shoot 4, park - RED alliance
svg.desc: Top view of the 141.35 by 141.35 inch BIOBUZZ field, audience at the bottom, red alliance on the left. Route partner_safe_rear_wall_b6 for the RED alliance, starting in tile B6, with 9 steps: 1 START at (28.0, 131.6, 90 deg); 2 DRIVE off the wall constant to 28.0, 123.0; 3 DRIVE past the FLOWER constant to 60.5, 123.0; 4 DRIVE to the shooting pose constant to 60.5, 131.0; 5 WAIT_FOR_TIP until the camera sees the HIVE tipped, giving up at 18.8 s on the route clock; 6 SHOOT 4 at UP cell from (60.5, 131.0, 90 deg); 7 DRIVE off the wall constant to 60.5, 112.0; 8 DRIVE to zone linear to 12.0, 108.0; 9 PARK at (12.0, 108.0, 0 deg). First tip: partner tips first, assumed at 12.0 s; latest that works 18.3 s. Estimated 21.6 s, POLLEN balance -4, up to 8 points for our robot; 0 errors and 0 warnings.

g.title: step 2: DRIVE off the wall constant to 28.0, 123.0 (t = 0.0 to 1.1 s) - Straight away from the wall, keeping the heading, so the front leaves the FLOWER's side before the robot goes east.
step 3: DRIVE past the FLOWER constant to 60.5, 123.0 (t = 1.1 to 2.8 s) - East along the rear side, below the FLOWER plate.

step 4: DRIVE to the shooting pose constant to 60.5, 131.0 (t = 2.8 to 3.9 s) - Up beside the FLOWER to the wall: the robot's left edge is 0.8 in clear of the FLOWER keep-out and its right edge 1.3 in short of the center line.
step 7: DRIVE off the wall constant to 60.5, 112.0 (t = 18.0 to 19.4 s) - Straight away from the rear wall toward the open floor, keeping the heading, so the robot does not turn next to the FLOWER.
step 8: DRIVE to zone linear to 12.0, 108.0 (t = 19.4 to 21.6 s) - Across the open floor above the HIVE keep-out while turning to face the zone, into the own LOADING ZONE.
step 1: START at (28.0, 131.6, 90 deg) (t = 0.0 to 0.0 s) - Front edge ON the rear wall, facing it, in tile B6. Straight, so the 3 degree margin is easy.

step 6: SHOOT 4 at UP cell from (60.5, 131.0, 90 deg) (t = 12.5 to 18.0 s) - 4 POLLEN into the empty cell do not tip it (it needs 8): they are banked for the second tip in TELEOP, so there is no spill here (G409).
step 9: PARK at (12.0, 108.0, 0 deg) (t = 21.6 to 21.6 s) - Overlaps the LOADING ZONE by 7.0 in (the zone is 11 in deep), standing 4.0 in off the wall so the LEAVE is kept too (QA21).
step 1: START at (28.0, 131.6, 90 deg) (t = 0.0 to 0.0 s) - Front edge ON the rear wall, facing it, in tile B6. Straight, so the 3 degree margin is easy.
step 2: DRIVE off the wall constant to 28.0, 123.0 (t = 0.0 to 1.1 s) - Straight away from the wall, keeping the heading, so the front leaves the FLOWER's side before the robot goes east.
step 3: DRIVE past the FLOWER constant to 60.5, 123.0 (t = 1.1 to 2.8 s) - East along the rear side, below the FLOWER plate.

step 4: DRIVE to the shooting pose constant to 60.5, 131.0 (t = 2.8 to 3.9 s) - Up beside the FLOWER to the wall: the robot's left edge is 0.8 in clear of the FLOWER keep-out and its right edge 1.3 in short of the center line.

step 5: WAIT_FOR_TIP until the camera sees the HIVE tipped, giving up at 18.8 s on the route clock (t = 3.9 to 12.5 s) - Waits for the CAMERA to see the rear cell up and steady (0.5 s), never for a time. 18.8 s on the route clock is the give-up time, the latest the rest of the route allows rounded down to a tenth: a partner that tips later gets no volley from us, the robot skips it and goes on to LEAVE and PARK.

step 6: SHOOT 4 at UP cell from (60.5, 131.0, 90 deg) (t = 12.5 to 18.0 s) - 4 POLLEN into the empty cell do not tip it (it needs 8): they are banked for the second tip in TELEOP, so there is no spill here (G409).
step 7: DRIVE off the wall constant to 60.5, 112.0 (t = 18.0 to 19.4 s) - Straight away from the rear wall toward the open floor, keeping the heading, so the robot does not turn next to the FLOWER.
step 8: DRIVE to zone linear to 12.0, 108.0 (t = 19.4 to 21.6 s) - Across the open floor above the HIVE keep-out while turning to face the zone, into the own LOADING ZONE.
step 9: PARK at (12.0, 108.0, 0 deg) (t = 21.6 to 21.6 s) - Overlaps the LOADING ZONE by 7.0 in (the zone is 11 in deep), standing 4.0 in off the wall so the LEAVE is kept too (QA21).
